english.title: Political party - out of time report - multiple / small donations

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: POLITICAL PARTIES ELECTIONS AND REFERENDUMS ACT 2000

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a donor who had made, during the course of a calendar year, small donations to a registered party, namely **(..SPECIFY PARTY..), whose aggregate value was more than £5000, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..),

(A)_[failed to deliver to the Electoral Commission a report of your donations in compliance with Section 68(2) of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000 before 31st January in the year following that in which the donations were made]_
(B)_[failed to accompany with your report to the Electoral Commission concerning your donations, a declaration stating that small donations whose aggregate value was that specified in the report were made by you to the specified registered party during the specified year and that no other small donations were made by you to the specified registered party during the specified year ]_
english.legislation:
Contrary to section 68(5)(b) of and Schedule 20 to the
Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) See Section 68(6) for definition of "small donation".
(ii) For this offence "specified" means specified in the report in question

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: One year imprisonment or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
